scope: Lean theorems over the Charon/Aeneas translation of crates/weft-core only. Not a refinement theorem for the parser, lowering, evaluator enumeration, reports or the whole binary, and not a renewal of any WEFT gate, runtime receipt or traceability binding.
statement: Proved over the Aeneas translation of crates/weft-core; trust base: the Charon/Aeneas translation, the Aeneas Lean library's models of the Rust core operations used, the Lean 4 kernel, and the standard axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

gate.command: cd proofs && docker compose run --build --rm proofs
gate.cold_image_note: tools stage reused from the shared local BuildKit cache (same pins and base digest as other writfold-dev proof images); the deps stage (mathlib cache download plus Aeneas library build) rebuilt because lakefile.toml/lake-manifest.json name this project.
gate.audit: AXIOM_AUDIT ok: 63 theorems, 20 required claims, axioms within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
gate.audit_note: 63 audited declarations = 38 hand-written theorems + 25 compiler-generated equation/sizeOf lemmas; the translation itself contains no axiom.

failed_attempts.reason: Mutant classify-refuting-as-support was rejected by Weft.Core.classify_loop_spec and also by Weft.Core.classify_spec, which the calibration then listed as unexpected: the mutation leaves `refuting` unassigned, so Aeneas drops it from the loop state and the loop signature changes. The expectation was widened to both theorems; no proof changed. 14 of 15 mutants calibrated; 168 s wall.

claims.statement: position_of returns the first position holding the value, or none iff the value is absent
contains is list membership
normalize equals the calculus's first-occurrence unique; duplicate-free with the same members
union = unique (left ++ right); duplicate-free; member iff in either side (operand lengths sum to at most usize::MAX)
intersection = left values on the right, in left order; member iff in both; preserves duplicate-freedom
difference = left values not on the right, in left order; member iff left and not right; preserves duplicate-freedom
subset is none iff every left value is on the right, otherwise the first left position that is not
same_members iff both sides have exactly the same members
a row supports iff premises and query hold, refutes iff premises hold and query fails, is excluded iff premises fail
verdict_of is the calculus's verdictOf
classify is verdictOf over (exists supporting row, exists refuting row)
Entailed iff some row is a premise model and the query holds in every premise model
Refuted iff some row is a premise model and the query fails in every premise model
Undetermined iff premise models of both polarities exist
InconsistentPremises iff no row is a premise model
same_bytes is byte-exact equality, length included
a comparison holds iff bytes are equal (Equal) or differ (Unequal)
refusals are exactly the unsatisfied positions, ascending
no refusal iff every comparison is satisfied
claims.mirrors: S14 reuse refuses any scope difference

claims.statement: any must-be-equal field with different bytes is refused
claims.mirrors: S14 reuse refuses any scope difference

contortions: No #[derive] or trait impls in the decision modules; Clone/Copy/Debug/PartialEq/Eq are hand-written in convenience.rs, outside [package.metadata.charon] start_from, with Debug output identical to the former derives.
Equality the theorems use is explicit: usize ==, and same_bytes for byte strings.
Owned data only: reuse comparisons own their bytes (Vec<u8>); set values are usize identities; no nested borrows.
No casts; indexed while loops instead of iterator adaptors.
Deref coercion (&vec) instead of Vec::as_slice, which the pinned Aeneas library translates to an axiom (observed in the first translation and removed).
Set searches are linear scans instead of hash sets: decisions cost O(|left|*|right|) comparisons, bounded by the unchanged linear work budget.
not_proved: Typing, budget charging, origin closure, quantifiers, lowering, traces and reports (A02, A04-A08, L/Q families): calculus proofs, tests, Lean/Rust differential and CLI scenarios only.
That evaluator trace rows enumerate every valuation and carry the premises' and query's values.
Which reuse fields are compared and their byte encodings.
The restatement of the calculus's unique and verdictOf in proofs/Kernel/Spec.lean is reviewed, not machine-linked: formal/ stays on Lean v4.21.0 and is not imported.
retired_note: Nothing was retired. Weft had no Verus family, and the Lean/Rust set-algebra differential (scripts/algebra_differential.py) also covers typing, refusals, origin reachability and end-to-end CLI behaviour that these theorems do not, so it is retained. The superseded statement that set_member/set_subset use hash sets was corrected in docs/rust-implementation.md.
requalification_pending: qualification/local-runtime.json, traceability.json and status.json bind the earlier source; the current source changes crates/weft-domain, weft-kernel, weft-wire and tools/weft-quality and adds crates/weft-core, so the private runtime/traceability producers must run again before any renewed runtime pass is claimed.
